ask: muse can u pair us up for the 2v2 teams and make it random
sentence: Randomly splits the people in the chat into 2v2 teams over three rounds so nobody has the same partner twice, or into a single 1v1 if only two or three are present.
use_when: a group of four wants random 2v2 teams for a game
everyone should get a different partner each round
two people need a quick random 1v1 matchup
teams need to be redrawn with a fresh shuffle
dont_use_when: teams need to be chosen by hand or by skill level
more than four people need to be split into several teams
a single random pick or a coin flip is needed
a score or bracket needs to be tracked
